replacements.instruction: 5.5 Robustness Checks は Appendix E の表を本文で再掲せず要約しているだけなので独立 subsection を削除し、5.2 の主 pairwise 結果をその場で qualification する最小限の感度分析要約だけを残す。cross-family で WritingBench の Agentic CogWriter vs SinglePass が反転する caveat は本文に残す。
replacements.before: Table~\ref{tab:pairwise-results} reports a system-level separation in direct same-prompt comparisons. \condAgenticCogWriter\ is preferred to \condSinglePass, \condStaged, and \condTaskPlanning, with across-benchmark mean win rates of \PooledFourOneRateMean, \PooledFourTwoRateMean, and \PooledFourThreeRateMean, respectively, when both presentation orders agree on a winner. The direction holds in every benchmark and generation run against \condSinglePass\ and \condTaskPlanning, and in all but one benchmark--run test against \condStaged. See Appendix~\ref{app:pairwise-detail} for the run-level intervals and corrected test decisions. The preference also persists under more conservative accounting: counting every attempted prompt yields win shares of \UncondFullSinglePassWinShare, \UncondFullStagedWinShare, and \UncondFullTaskPlanningWinShare, and assigning every missing pair against \condAgenticCogWriter\ still leaves win rates of at least \WorstCaseFullSinglePassRate, \WorstCaseFullStagedRate, and \WorstCaseFullTaskPlanningRate\ among comparisons with an agreed winner.
replacements.after: Table~\ref{tab:pairwise-results} reports a system-level separation in direct same-prompt comparisons. \condAgenticCogWriter\ is preferred to \condSinglePass, \condStaged, and \condTaskPlanning, with across-benchmark mean win rates of \PooledFourOneRateMean, \PooledFourTwoRateMean, and \PooledFourThreeRateMean, respectively, when both presentation orders agree on a winner. The direction holds in every benchmark and generation run against \condSinglePass\ and \condTaskPlanning, and in all but one benchmark--run test against \condStaged. See Appendix~\ref{app:pairwise-detail} for the run-level intervals and corrected test decisions. The preference also persists under more conservative accounting: counting every attempted prompt yields win shares of \UncondFullSinglePassWinShare, \UncondFullStagedWinShare, and \UncondFullTaskPlanningWinShare, and assigning every missing pair against \condAgenticCogWriter\ still leaves win rates of at least \WorstCaseFullSinglePassRate, \WorstCaseFullStagedRate, and \WorstCaseFullTaskPlanningRate\ among comparisons with an agreed winner. Resource-matched sensitivity analyses in Appendix~\ref{app:sensitivity-analyses} largely preserve the pairwise direction, whereas cross-family rescoring is less stable and reverses the WritingBench direction against \condSinglePass.

replacements.instruction: 独立した 5.5 Robustness Checks は削除し、詳細な output-length / compute / cross-family analyses と表は Appendix E に置く。本文では 5.2 の主結果に必要な qualification のみ残す。
